critical_code_review_comments: timetable.py:52-140 class_subject_coverage — clean implementation. Pre-builds subject_map and teacher_map once → O(slots) main loop. teacher_ids stored as set during aggregation guarantees de-duplication. Cross-tenant safety: teachers query is filtered by user['school_id'] from rdb.users (root DB), and slots/classes/subjects pulled from tenant_db scoped to same school_id — no leakage risk. Uses {'_id': 0} projection everywhere — no ObjectId serialisation issues.

timetable.py: matrix row is emitted for EVERY section even when classes have empty sections list because the inner loop is `for sec in (c.get('sections') or [])` — sections_total correctly reflects sum over classes. If a class doc has sections=null/missing it is silently skipped (defensive `or []`).

timetable.py: subject_coverage rows are sorted by subject_name (stable display) but missing_subjects keeps the input order (already sorted by name from the initial .sort('name',1) on subjects) — consistent.

timetable.py minor: teacher_ids set is iterated to produce the teachers list — order is not deterministic across runs. If UI relies on stable ordering, consider `sorted(row['teacher_ids'])`. Not currently a bug since UI sorts/keys by id.

ClassesPage.jsx ClassSubjectMatrix: testids are stable (class-cov-row-<classid>-<section>) and unique. class-cov-sub-<key>-<sid> and class-cov-miss-<key>-<sid> include both row-key and subject-id for full uniqueness across the matrix. class-cov-class-filter is a native <select> (consistent with the rest of the app) — accessible and testable.

ClassesPage.jsx: 'Hide sections without a timetable' toggle is purely client-side filter on has_timetable=false — correct. The footer hint 'Tip: 3 section(s) have no timetable yet. Set them up from the Timetable page.' is a nice usability cue.

Minor UX: class-cov-unscheduled is conditionally rendered only when unscheduled_subjects.length>0 — clean (no empty warning area). When the DEMO seed expands beyond Grade 5/6 there may be unscheduled subjects to verify — covered by backend test_unscheduled_subjects_truly_unscheduled.
